test_case_name: Open Cookie Policy from Cookie Banner (Parent to Child)

intents.intent: Click 'Più opzioni' link in the cookie banner on the parent page
And then check that the 'Cookies' page is displayed

test_case_name: Accept All Cookies from Cookie Policy Page (Child)

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' button on the 'Cookies' page
And then check that all cookies are accepted and the cookie banner is dismissed
Click 'Più opzioni' link on the 'Cookies' page
Click 'Accetto' radio button for cookie di profilazione (prima parte)
Click 'Accetta tutti i cookie di terze parti' radio button
Click 'Conferma' button for cookie di terze parti
And then check that the cookie preferences are saved and the banner is dismissed

test_case_name: Deny All Third-Party Cookies and Confirm (Child)

intents.intent: Click 'Nega il consenso a tutti i cookie di terze parti' radio button
Click 'Conferma' button for cookie di terze parti
And then check that all third-party cookies are denied and the preferences are saved

test_case_name: Perform Desktop Search from Cookie Policy Page

intents.intent: Type $name into 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field
Click 'Cerca (desktop)' button
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name

test_case_name: Perform Mobile Search from Cookie Policy Page

intents.intent: Type $name into 'Cerca' input field
Click 'Cerca (mobile)' button
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name

test_case_name: Login as Guest from Cookie Policy Page

intents.intent: Type $email into 'E-mail' input field
Type $name into 'Password' input field
Click 'ENTRA' button
And then check that the guest user is logged in successfully

test_case_name: Login as Guest and Remember Access from Cookie Policy Page

intents.intent: Type $email into 'E-mail' input field
Type $name into 'Password' input field
Click 'Mantieni L'accesso' checkbox
Click 'ENTRA' button
And then check that the guest user is logged in and the session is remembered

test_case_name: Recover Password from Cookie Policy Page

intents.intent: Click 'Recupera Password' link
And then check that the password recovery process is initiated

test_case_name: Register as New User from Cookie Policy Page

intents.intent: Click 'Registrati' link
And then check that the registration process is started

test_case_name: Access Inbiz from Cookie Policy Page

intents.intent: Click 'ACCEDI' link
And then check that the Inbiz login page is displayed

test_case_name: Open Online Security Information from Cookie Policy Page

intents.intent: Click 'Scopri come fare' link
And then check that the online security information page is displayed
